## For a new rule

- [ ] `rules/AG0NN-<name>/rule.yml`
- [ ] `fixtures/bad*`, which triggers the rule
- [ ] `fixtures/good*`, a realistic near miss that stays clean
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Severity matches the table in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] No real credentials in the fixtures
